commitCadence: Commit after each independently verified slice with its Theseus evidence.
stopConditions: Stop immediately if approved fraction visuals or semantic traces regress.
Stop if the cancellation guardrail requires unapproved migration beyond cancellation assets.

Stop at the final human visual checkpoint before any family promotion.
